card.line: Ashdod was a Philistine city near the Mediterranean coast, where the captured ark of God was taken and where Dagon fell before the LORD.

moments.title: Dagon falls before the ark
moments.text: The Philistines set the ark of God beside Dagon's statue in his temple at Ashdod. Two mornings in a row, Dagon was found fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD, and the second time his head and hands were broken off.

moments.title: The LORD's hand is heavy on Ashdod
moments.text: The hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and He afflicted them with tumors. The men of Ashdod said the ark of the God of Israel must not stay with them.

moments.title: Uzziah tears down the walls
moments.text: King Uzziah went to war against the Philistines and tore down the walls of Ashdod. Then he built cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines.

moments.title: Assyria captures Ashdod
moments.text: Sargon king of Assyria sent his chief commander, who attacked and captured Ashdod. The LORD used Isaiah's walk, naked and barefoot, as a sign of what would come on Egypt and Cush.

moments.title: Children who speak Ashdod's language
moments.text: Nehemiah saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod. Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod and could not speak the language of Judah.
